q: On 2026-10-02 we recorded a loss. Quantify exactly how much of the profit deterioration versus 2026-10-01 came from lower revenue, advertising cost, COGS, discounts, refunds, shipping, payment costs, and other available cost components. Reconcile the components back to the total profit change.
answer:
Net profit fell by ₹16,570 on 2026-10-02 vs 2026-10-01; the drop reconciles exactly to a ₹43,254 fall in P&L net sales, partially offset by lower COGS and lower ad spend (see bridge below).

What changed (signed changes, effect on net profit)
- Net sales (P&L basis): 2026-10-02 ₹31,341 vs 2026-10-01 ₹74,595 → change −₹43,254 (effect on net profit: −₹43,254)
- Net COGS: 2026-10-02 ₹13,544 vs 2026-10-01 ₹29,764 → change −₹16,220 (effect on net profit: +₹16,220)
- Ad spend (P&L basis): 2026-10-02 ₹35,505 vs 2026-10-01 ₹45,968 → change −₹10,463 (effect on net profit: +₹10,463)

These three lines reconcile the net profit change: −₹43,254 + ₹16,220 + ₹10,463 = −₹16,571 (rounding yields the reported −₹16,570).

Additional available cost / deduction lines (how their day‑to‑day moves contributed)
- Return revenue (P&L basis): ₹9,360 → ₹14,018 → change −₹4,658 → effect on profit: +₹4,658
- Discounts (P&L basis): ₹1,842 → ₹2,793 → change −₹951 → effect on profit: +₹951
- Shipping cost: ₹1,981 → ₹3,489 → change −₹1,508 → effect on profit: +₹1,508
- Operating cost: ₹3,015 → ₹5,345 → change −₹2,329 → effect on profit: +₹2,329
- Packaging cost: ₹360 → ₹920 → change −₹560 → effect on profit: +₹560
- Payment gateway fees: ₹305 → ₹442 → change −₹137 → effect on profit: +₹137
- RTO cost: ₹370 → ₹494 → change −₹124 → effect on profit: +₹124

Note: the canonical reconciliation in the P&L (net sales − net COGS − ad spend = net profit) already includes where these lines sit (for example returns and discounts reduce net sales; packaging, shipping, payment fees, RTO and some operating costs sit in COGS/operating lines). The three-line bridge above is the exact accounting identity that reconciles to the total net profit change; the additional lines show the day-to-day movements of measurable components and their signed effects when viewed individually.

Period: 2026-10-02 vs 2026-10-01 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
